evidence.title: Fullpack - Packing & Outfit App - App Store

name: Fullpack - Packing & Outfit
summary: iPhone packing app that inventories your gear from photos and builds trip checklists and outfits.
description: A travel app from Signer Labs: photograph an item and AI extracts, names and files it into a smart inventory, then build packing lists and plan outfits for every trip. An AI virtual try-on (Pro) previews outfits from one full-body photo. Free with in-app purchases; listed under Utilities on the App Store.
contains: AI item recognition from photos into a digital inventory
packing lists and outfit planning per trip
AI virtual try-on from a full-body photo (Pro)
free with in-app purchases; iPhone only, 66.3 MB
